These edits remove the absolute-position embedding, its initialization, and its index calculation. Dropout and masking now apply directly to the existing scaled item embeddings, while causal convolutions retain relative-order information.

All interfaces, constants, eight independent gated blocks, dilations, residual scales, item initialization, normalization, padding masks, and tied scoring remain unchanged. The positions variable in score_candidates is preserved.

This is one candidate for the unchanged frozen host protocol. Retain it only if host validation HR@10 exceeds 0.645; 0.655 remains an experimental target. No validation improvement is claimed before host execution.
